📖 System Overview

A complete POS platform designed for retail businesses with bilingual support (Khmer/English), real-time inventory, multi-payment processing, and comprehensive business analytics.

🛒

Point of Sale

Fast checkout with barcode scanning, cart management, and multi-payment support

📊

Analytics

Dashboard with KPIs, revenue charts, top products, and cashier performance metrics

🌐

Bilingual

Full English & Khmer (ភាសាខ្មែរ) with real-time switching

📦

Inventory

Real-time stock tracking with low-stock alerts and barcode lookups

💳

Multi-Payment

Cash (with change), ABA scan-to-pay, Credit/Debit Card

🛡️

Role-Based Access

Granular Admin & Cashier permissions with JWT authentication

🛠️ Tech Stack

⚙️ Backend (NestJS)

◈ NestJS 10 — Application framework (Node.js)
◈ TypeORM 0.3 — ORM with MySQL driver
◈ MySQL 8.4 / TiDB Cloud — Database
◈ Passport + JWT — Authentication
◈ bcryptjs — Password hashing
◈ class-validator — DTO validation
◈ Swagger / OpenAPI — API docs
◈ Cloudinary / Sharp — Image processing
◈ Helmet — Security headers

🎨 Frontend (Angular)

◈ Angular 21 — Modern SPA framework
◈ Angular Material — UI components
◈ Tailwind CSS 3 — Utility-first styling
◈ @ngx-translate — i18n (Khmer/English)
◈ Angular Signals — Reactive state
◈ Angular Animations — Transitions

☁️ Infrastructure

◈ Docker & Docker Compose — Containerization
◈ Render — Backend hosting (Docker)
◈ Vercel — Frontend hosting
◈ TiDB Cloud — MySQL-compatible DB
◈ Cloudinary — Image CDN & storage
◈ MinIO — S3-compatible local storage

📡 API Reference

RESTful API at /api/v1 with consistent JSON envelope responses

MethodEndpointAuthDescription
POST /auth/login ✗ Login → returns JWT + user profile
POST /sales ✓ Create sale (validates & deducts stock)
GET /products ✓ List products (paginated, filterable)
GET /products/barcode/:code ✓ Barcode lookup
GET /reports/summary ✓ Dashboard KPIs + low-stock alerts
GET /reports/top-products ✓ Best-selling products
GET /reports/daily-revenue ✓ Revenue grouped by day
GET /reports/sales-by-cashier ✓ Performance per cashier
PATCH /products/:id ✓ Update product (admin only) 
// Standard response envelope
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": { ... },
  "timestamp": "2026-06-15T14:30:00.000Z"
}
// Login response
{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1, "name": "System Admin",
    "email": "admin@pos.com", "role": "admin"
  }
}

📘 Full Swagger docs at /api/docs — Auto-authorization included!

🗄️ Database Schema

8 core entities with relationships modeled via TypeORM

users
id, name, email (unique), password (hashed),
role (admin/cashier), is_active, avatar_url,
reset_token, reset_token_expiry, created_at
products
id, name, name_kh, img_url, barcode (unique),
price, stock, category_id → categories,
description, is_active, low_stock_threshold
sales
id, user_id → users, subtotal, discount, tax,
total, payment_method (cash/aba/card), created_at
sale_items
id, sale_id → sales, product_id → products,
quantity, price (snapshot), discount (per-item)
categories
id, name, name_kh, description, img_url, is_active
management_pages
id, title, title_km, icon, type (menu/link),
url, permissions, badge, sort_order, parent_id
file_uploads
id, original_file_name, file_url,
file_extension, file_size, upload_type, destination_storage

🔗 Relationships: products → categories (M:1), sales → users (M:1), sale_items → sales/products (M:1)

🛡️ Role-Based Permissions

Clear separation of duties between Admin and Cashier roles

🛒 Create Sales✅✅
📋 View All Sales✅❌
📦 View Products✅✅
✏️ Create/Edit Products✅❌
📁 View Categories✅✅
✏️ Create/Edit Categories✅❌
👥 Manage Users✅❌
🔐 Manage Roles & Permissions✅❌
📊 Reports & Analytics✅❌
🗂️ Management Pages✅❌
🖼️ File Uploads✅❌

👑 Admin

Full system access — product CRUD, user management, reports, settings, all sales data

👤 Cashier

Focused POS access — create sales, view products & categories, view own transactions only
